summary: NatWest Group plc files a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of $1.25 billion 4.983% Senior Callable Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Notes due 2032 under an underwriting agreement with NatWest Markets Securities Inc. The filing includes the underlying indenture, pricing agreement, and legal opinions. This is a routine debt offering, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The proceeds are for general corporate purposes, with no change in control, strategic review, or shareholder return program announced. As a foreign private issuer, NatWest uses Form 6-K to furnish the material terms of the note issuance to the SEC.
